changelog:
Skill Discovery SEO is a packaging and metadata optimization skill for agent-facing skills. It helps
  improve discoverability across registries and ecosystems by tightening skill names, frontmatter
  descriptions, display names, short descriptions, default prompts, tags, and example prompts.

  Use it when you are publishing a new skill, renaming an existing one, refining trigger language, or
  trying to improve how meta-agents and search systems retrieve and trust a skill. It is designed for
  practical skill SEO: clearer names, stronger query coverage, better semantic matching, and tighter scope.
  It does not try to broaden a skill artificially. Instead, it makes the skill easier to route correctly by
  humans and agents.

  This skill is useful for creators publishing skills to ecosystems like ClawHub, Codex-style registries,
  OpenClaw, Claude-oriented agent systems, and other skill-based platforms.
